youtube_title: Wrong Item but Seller Says No Return? You Still Get a Refund. Rules You Didn't Know #17 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #17. You open your online order and it's the wrong item. The seller says it's a no return product. Refund or not? A or B?
Answer: B, you get a refund. Under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020, a seller can't refuse to take back goods or refund if they are defective, deficient, wrong or not as advertised. A no return policy covers a change of mind, not a broken or wrong item. Every e-commerce site must have a grievance officer who resolves complaints within a month. Still ignored? National Consumer Helpline 1915, then an online complaint at the consumer commission (no fee for claims up to Rs 5 lakh). Tip: film your unboxing.
Sources: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020; Consumer Protection Act 2019.
